observedBehaviors: Metadata saves retain original exact stored credential including nil/empty and do not create a Keychain generation.
Actual edited bytes, including canonical-Unicode-equivalent but byte-different strings, use original protected save.
Explicit migration uses only selected original record and rejects protected handles, built-in markers, empty keys or unstaged/changed drafts.
Stale durable row guards precede checkpointing; original save/verify/rollback behavior and retained generation recovery remain intact.
New custom provider uses original staged insert rather than compatibility plaintext insert.
Missing reference requires explicit user replacement; normal no-edit save remains blocked after load failure.
Compact publication retry remains separate from credential save; current canonical additionally guards retry with !migrate.
limitations: Source review only, no new native SwiftData/Keychain test execution.
Existing guards are not claimed to provide an atomic cross-process/CloudKit compare-and-swap.
Original provider request await/rotation window is a separate follow-on owned by runtime_cache_finish.
Historical SQLite/CloudKit plaintext erasure and cross-device synchronization latency are not claimed.
